controlled_stop.behavior: Device-owned stop drains/finalizes/unmounts via the handoff coordinator, tears down USB and does not automatically resume. Terminal faults then revoke charge, force the storage rail off and enter PA0/WKUP1-low Standby without VBUS. Host/recovery faults prioritize emergency rail cutoff over an incomplete tail.

voltage_policy.threshold: No production default.3600mV used only for build/test, not battery qualification
voltage_policy.sampling: Configured mode attempts every1000ms only during quiet device ownership; value stale at2500ms
voltage_policy.invalid: Three consecutive attempted acquisition failures latch a terminal fault. Independently, five seconds without a valid sample during device ownership is terminal, covering a permanently busy queue or lost acquisition opportunity. These are firmware bounds; blocked synchronous storage can still delay main-loop observation and must be measured.
voltage_policy.latch: No automatic restart on voltage rebound; host ownership pauses missing-data grace
voltage_policy.tests: Threshold equality, healthy reading, latch, timer wrap, invalid timeout and ownership grace reset; fast-monitor three-failure and five-second freshness bounds; real main runtime ADC-failure controlled-stop and terminal-Standby integration; full38-check non-hardware regression

startup_preflight.ordering: After GPIO and16MHz clock setup, before recorder_boot_start, therefore before SD power startup/probe/mount/recovery/audio DMA
startup_preflight.qualification: 100ms is20x nominal1M||1M with10nF time constant; ADC/rail settling still needs hardware verification

startup_preflight.margin: 100mV provisional bench margin, not guaranteed shutdown reserve
startup_preflight.limitation: Low voltage blocks recording boot. USB insertion reset-wakes into the export-only/charge path, covered by mocked main integration; physical wake, charge current, rail margin and import behavior remain NOT_RUN.

terminal_storage_poweroff.sequence: drain/finalize/identity/sync/unmount -> USB teardown -> SPI deinit and analog no-pull pins -> SD_EN low -> disk.ready false
terminal_storage_poweroff.fault: Normal shutdown requires SPI release. In an already-latched terminal fault, the irreversible emergency path attempts SPI release but always drives SD_EN low, forbids same-reset restart and may discard only the incomplete tail.
terminal_storage_poweroff.tests: Power driver ordering/release failure, irreversible emergency SD_EN-low behavior, runtime normal/cooperative shutdown/repeat rejection/failure and terminal-fault Standby integration; mocked electrical behavior
terminal_storage_poweroff.limitation: Card rail decay/backpower and final write completion margin need physical measurement; no restart before reset

terminal_audio_shutdown.basis: Pinned STM32 HAL AcqStop_DMA disables filter/DMA, leaves common clock generator; DeInit disables generator for last ADF instance
terminal_audio_shutdown.sequence: Require stopped boundary and HAL_READY -> HAL_MDF_DeInit -> latchPB3low -> outputPB3low -> PB4analog/no pull -> disableADF1 peripheral clock
terminal_audio_shutdown.scope: Terminal controlled stop only; normalUSB handoff remains resumable
terminal_audio_shutdown.tests: check_audio_shutdown.sh ASan/UBSan pass: null/state/IRQ/masked IRQ/unacknowledged boundary rejected without IO; HAL deinit failure prevents GPIO changes; deinit->GPIO latch low->CLK output->DATA analog->ADF clock disable ordered. ARM application link pass after split into audio_shutdown.c.
terminal_audio_shutdown.remaining: Physical clock-low/rail current not measured; MSIK oscillator and shared LPDMA clock remain. HAL is mocked in driver test.

low_battery_standby.sequence: After controlled recording/storage/audio stop, revoke charge request, force LED off, configure PA0 VBUS_N as active-low WKUP1, close the VBUS race, then enter Standby. USB insertion reset-wakes the MCU; startup ADC and cutoff checks run again before export and charging.
low_battery_standby.safety_basis: STM32U585 Standby keeps BOR active while switching off VCORE and HSI/MSI/PLL clocks. It avoids the former 1ms SysTick wake loop. The protected pack remains the final over-discharge barrier; firmware Standby is not an indefinite-storage guarantee.
low_battery_standby.tests: check_low_battery_standby.sh ASan/UBSan covers IRQ rejection, charge revoke, LED off, VBUS-already-present, attach race and Standby entry; check_application_export.sh covers cold and recording-triggered low-voltage paths; configured U585 application links.
low_battery_standby.physical_acceptance: All five packs: completed-device standby current <=150uA, wake/reset to 9-11mA charge <=1000ms, no completed-file corruption, pack protection behavior recorded.
